report.explanation: All 12 gateway checkout observations returned 200 with durations 47-297ms; traces show every span ok with no errors, and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. The p95 of 412ms is a histogram estimate not corroborated by the sampled requests. No evidence establishes any taxonomy cause; the alert does not demonstrate a fault.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual checkout failures or error spans (non-200 statuses, exceptions) to substantiate http-500 or downstream-latency
Per-dependency latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout
DB connection pool saturation metrics (pool size/idle over time) to test db-pool-exhaustion
Memory retention time series per service to test memory-leak
Deployment/configuration change records to test bad-configuration
Clarification of the alert's expected threshold and why 200-status requests triggered it
